Occupational English Test
 WRITING SUB-TEST:                 MEDICINE
 TIME ALLOWED:                     READING TIME: 5 MINUTES
                                   WRITING TIME:          40 MINUTES

 Read the case notes and complete the writing task which follows.

 You are a GP in a city clinic. Ms. Smile is a patient in your clinic.
 PATIENT DETAILS:



 Name:               Ms. Roth Smile
 DOB:                12/03/1977
 Social background:
                 Divorced
                     Full time librarian
                     Physically     active,    participates    in
                     swimming, swims regularly 4 hours a
                     week
                     Lives alone near parents

 Family history:     mother osteoarthrits (1998) father heart and lung problem (2010)
 Medical background:
Tonsilitis
Appendicetomy
Depressed on two
treatments

Presenting complaint
Pain R shoulder
Decreased range of movement
3/9/2020
Subjective
shoulder pain
stiffness
affected DAL hand washing cleaning can’t lift right shoulder so cant swim
Objective
pain abduction over 45
pain stiff on palpation
supraspinatus infraspinatus pain during active rotation and passive flexion
Management plan
ibrupofen ice rest
Us
one week review
10/9
us results tear of supraspinatus
15*13 mm inflammed bursa
acroclavicular degenration

13/9
discussed of us results
stressed and desprate to start swimming pain
slight improved but her quality of life still bad

Goal: decrease pain restore muscle strength get full range of movement
 
Writing Task:

Using the information given in the case notes, write a letter of referral to Mr. James, a physiotherapist, for
management of Ms. Smile’s injury. Address this letter to Mr. James Warden, 23 Emerald Street, Parkville.


In your answer:
     ●   Expand the relevant notes into complete sentences
     ●   Do not use note form
     ●   Use letter format
The body of the letter should be approximately 180–200 words.
